blind_spots_patched: Baseline Ch 4 failed to size private incumbent VKC Nuts (Nutraj), missed the Oct 2026 FMCG-major stake-sale process for Farmley (Emami, ITC, Britannia, Orkla), and had zero quantitative data on quick-commerce private-label share or the 30-34% quick-commerce channel take-rate colliding with PROV's 23% brand gross margin.

Baseline Ch 3 left US walnut/almond tariff relief unverified and failed to quantify 2026 INR depreciation, FSSAI non-tariff customs clearance friction, and RBI monetary tightening against PROV's unhedged ₹281 Cr FX import book and doubled floating-rate debt.

Baseline Ch 6 overlooked PROV's Non-Ind AS (IGAAP) SME accounting cliff upon any mainboard migration, H1 FY27 unexplained growth in Fixed Assets (+₹22 Cr vs ₹14 Cr Surat Phase 1) and Other Liabilities (+₹16 Cr beyond payables), and 3,350 contingent share warrants in core subsidiary Prov Foods.
assumptions_changed: WEAKENED: India's 100% duty on US walnuts and ₹100/kg almond kernel duty had unverified cut prospects by Nov 2026, and unhedged ₹281 Cr FX imports carried only generic price-pass-through lag risk.
WEAKENED: PROV is a genuine top-tier player by scale beside Farmley (₹394 Cr) and Happilo (₹280 Cr), with no retrievable revenue for Nutraj and no sourced figures for platform private labels.
WEAKENED: The FY2026 earnings call had no published transcript, post-FY24 channel mix was undisclosed, and NSE mainboard migration remained unfiled.
CONFIRMED: Surat Phase 1 completed in Nov 2026 (₹14 Cr capex) with Phases 2-3 due June 2027 targeting 5+ lakh pouches/day (~4.5x H1 FY27 daily average of ~1.1 lakh).
CONFIRMED: Audited EBITDA ex-other income stays thin (1.99% FY26, 2.51% H1 FY27) while H1 FY27 CFO of −₹57.6 Cr swung ₹19.6 Cr net cash into ~₹51 Cr net debt as borrowings doubled to ₹56.4 Cr.
